description: Source code for a FreeType font driver handling PCF font files, including font loading, glyph rendering, and character mapping.

classes.name: PCF_CMapRec
classes.description: Character map structure for PCF fonts, holding encoding data.

methods.name: pcf_cmap_init
methods.description: Initializes a character map with encoding data from the face.

methods.name: pcf_cmap_char_index
methods.description: Returns the glyph index for a given character code.

methods.name: pcf_cmap_char_next
methods.description: Returns the next character code and glyph index after a given code.

methods.name: PCF_Face_Done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a PCF face.

methods.name: PCF_Face_Init
methods.description: Initializes a PCF face, loading font data and setting up charmap.

methods.name: PCF_Size_Select
methods.description: Selects a font size based on strike index.

methods.name: PCF_Size_Request
methods.description: Handles size requests for the font face.

methods.name: PCF_Glyph_Load
methods.description: Loads glyph bitmap and metrics for a given glyph index.

methods.name: pcf_get_bdf_property
methods.description: Retrieves a BDF property from the font face.

methods.name: pcf_get_charset_id
methods.description: Gets charset encoding and registry identifiers.

methods.name: pcf_driver_requester
methods.description: Handles service requests for the driver.
